## PROBLEM

The accepted ISSUE-127 receipt at SHA-256 2ae04250 records that a fresh market-data generated worktree lacks repo-local default Service Knowledge machinery. Market-data PR #595 changes .xtrm from ignore-by-default to track-by-default and should remove that consumer blocker after merge.

## SUCCESS

After https://github.com/mercuryintelligence/market-data/pull/595 merges, a clean fresh clone at the merged commit runs the packed Core eede9290 / Specialists f263a228 market-data matrix without the prior local-only workaround, executes tracked .xtrm/skills/default/service-knowledge machinery, binds the market-data umbrella automatically, preserves consumer state, restores global installs, cleans all residue, and emits a new integrity-bound receipt that explicitly supersedes only the machinery finding in the accepted receipt.

## SCOPE

Fresh-clone market-data verification only; locally packed artifacts already bound by xtrm-lk07w.15; real pre-script, xt Pi/Claude role startup, tracked Specialists run, restoration, cleanup, and receipt delta.

## NON_GOALS

No publication. No Core or Specialists source changes. Do not alter the accepted receipt. Do not claim 17/17 umbrella parity unless repository-ci-cd is separately added and verified.

## CONSTRAINTS

Blocked until PR #595 is merged. Audit-only prompts. No production consumer mutation. Preserve Core eede9290 and Specialists f263a228. Use a fresh clone and record exact market-data commit. Remove all session, worktree, branch, scratch, clone, proxy, HOME, and prefix residue.

## VALIDATION

- [ ] PR #595 merge commit is present in the fresh clone.
- [ ] Tracked default Service Knowledge scripts exist without a local workaround commit.
- [ ] Packed xt pi and xt claude role launches bind project-pack Service Knowledge.
- [ ] Tracked Specialists run executes repo-local default scope/drift machinery before Pi.
- [ ] Global package trees and binary links restore byte-for-byte.
- [ ] Broad residue inventory is zero.
- [ ] New reviewer and security audits PASS the superseding receipt.

## OUTPUT

New receipt path/hash, manifest hash/count, exact source/artifact/consumer commits, pass/fail matrix, cleanup proof, audit task IDs, and a precise delta from receipt 2ae04250.
